svg.title: Dialysis and the distance to a bus stop in Rhode Island
svg.text: Where the bus stops short of dialysis
Two of 16 clinics are more than a kilometre from the nearest RIPTA fixed-route stop.
Tiverton and Westerly had zero early trips within 800 m on both study days.
Window: 5–8 a.m., Nov. 17 and 21, 2026. Distances are straight lines from clinic addresses.
Sources: CMS dialysis facility listing · RIPTA scheduled service · U.S. Census cartographic boundaries
